svg.desc: Horizontal stacked bars of model-state bytes per parameter on each of 4 GPUs. DDP replicates 2 bytes of fp16 parameters, 2 of fp16 gradients and 12 of fp32 optimizer state: 16. ZeRO-1 shards the optimizer state: 7. ZeRO-2 also shards gradients: 5.5. ZeRO-3 or FSDP also shards parameters: 4.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Model-state memory per GPU: DDP vs ZeRO stages
